SetInstanceRecordConfig.summary: Configure instance screen recording settings, including adding, updating, and shutting down screen recording configurations.

schema.description: Specifies whether to enable the screen recording configuration: If set to true, the configuration for the instance is updated if it exists or created if it does not exist. If set to false, the screen recording configuration for the instance is disabled.
The instance ID.

The target storage address for screen recordings. Valid value:  
The target storage address for screen recordings is an OSS bucket, formatted as acs:oss:{RegionId}:{ResourceOwnerId}:{BucketName}/{PathName}.  
ResourceOwnerId is the Account ID of the Alibaba Cloud account that owns the OSS bucket.  
Note:  
The BucketName of an OSS bucket created by the user must follow the naming format: workbench-record-[Account ID]-[Custom string].

Expiration period in days.  
Default Value: 7.
The Region where the instance resides.
